Method of Attack: Trojanized VPN apps that provide legitimate VPN functionality while exfiltrating sensitive information such as contacts, call logs, location details, SMS, chats from messaging apps (Signal, Viber, WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook Messenger), and file lists from external storage
Attack Vector: Distribution via fake websites (e.g., thesecurevpn), possibly phishing over email, social media, or other communication channels; apps not available on Google Play
